description:
Failures found while minimizing the distiller over a map built from file lines. Re-probed 2026-11-13 on develop 3f638b736 (includes fz-348.1-.3, fz-sc8.139, fz-rs7.4), argument tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl:
1. STILL FAILS: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/m2.fz — error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: boxed closure call in FunctionId(438) expects delivered lane(s) [RawAtom] but the construction wrapper publishes [ValueRef]. Not cured by the GH #302 remedy (fz-348); that hypothesis is refuted.
2. FIXED by fz-sc8.139: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/d2.fz no longer reports 'missed an exhaustive dispatch' or hangs; it reaches the program's own FunctionClauseError in Distill.cell/1. The earlier attribution to Map.new being specced :: any was wrong; the cause was the wide-receiver impl demand.
3. STILL FAILS: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/a2.fz — error[spec/violation]: call to zip/2 violates its @spec for arguments (int | binary, [int | binary]); the declared domain is ([a0_e], [a1_e]).
Remaining work: after fz-sc8.123 (Map functions return maps), re-run 1 and 3 on all three paths against elixir; one ticket per distinct surviving cause; close this one.

comments.text: Item 1 (boxed closure call expects [RawInt], wrapper publishes [ValueRef]) is likely the GH #302 fault: Types::closure_lit mints closure types with free arrow vars, so has_vars(closure) is always true and ground_dispatch_surfaces drops the closure surface (boxed_contract.rs:273). #302's proposal (page /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-302.html, fz-50's session) fixes it with one predicate ignoring a closure literal's own arrow vars. Not reproducible on develop (no File.stream/Stream there). Re-check item 1 once #302 lands under #274; fold only if it no longer reproduces.

title: Minimize and ticket two failures over a map built from file lines
